note: Zone of the B25 first-floor gallery (R_world_02): the geography classroom (La salle de géographie) behind the gallery's panelled door. Duck-egg blue walls, pale ash floor, green blackboard, pull-down world map; landmark: the model city and the long desk railway. Feminine LEFT of the offset divider (6 feminine words): teacher with a red apple on her tablet (application); bored boy yawning as he paints a map border (bordure); gorilla climbing a pole in a model city with a metro train (métropole); prefect girl leading three tourists to a model of the grand prefecture building (préfecture); blue jay on the pointer at the graph on the map (géographie); geese with tiny suitcases (immigration). RIGHT: green regional train between two villages on the long desk (régional, adj). Exit: panelled door back centre-right -> gallery R_world_02 (lavender walls and flags visible). Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3).
